great.name: Room rent: No limit / any room (base plan statement)
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: The wording indicates no default room-rent cap/room-category restriction in the base hospitalization benefit (i.e., you can choose any room). Note: there is a separate optional ‘Room Type Modification’ feature that can introduce room-category based co-pay/proportionate deductions if you choose a restricted room eligibility.

great.name: PED waiting period as low as 12 months (variant-dependent)
great.quote: “...Pre-existing Disease (PED) ... shall be excluded until the expiry of 12months/24 months/ 36 months (as per Variant selected) of continuous coverage...”
great.explanation: A 12-month PED waiting period is best-in-class (available in some variants). Other variants may have 24/36 months which are still acceptable.

great.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period as low as 12 months (variant-dependent)
great.quote: “...listed conditions... shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months/12 months (as per Variant Selected) of continuous coverage...”
great.reference: Section 5.1.2 Specified disease/procedure waiting period (Code- Excl02)
great.explanation: A 12-month specific-illness waiting period is best-in-class (available in some variants).

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer / restore: ReAssure+ / ReAssureX (unlimited reinstatement after first paid claim)
great.quote: “ReAssure “Forever”: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: This is a strong ‘restore/additional SI’ mechanism: once triggered, it can provide additional coverage beyond the base SI multiple times (subject to the per-claim cap up to Base Sum Insured).

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (standard)
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident...”
good.explanation: 30 days is the industry-standard initial waiting period for illnesses (accidents covered from day 1).

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 60 days

good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization (Pre & Post hospitalization)

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 180 days

good.name: Air ambulance cover (limit up to Base Sum Insured; emergency only)

good.name: Domiciliary / Home care treatment covered (with conditions)

good.name: Organ donor hospitalization expenses covered (when recipient claim is paid)
